verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists a PPT assistant with template selection and smart layout, plus Agent-built webpages that support multi-round modification and sharing. Kimi Code can also edit local files through conversation. These are only topic titles, though, and nothing documents creating general documents or exporting files. missing for 10: documented document (e.g. Word/PDF) creation, explicit export/download formats, evidence of iterative editing for presentations, hands-on or independent corroboration.
